definitions.explanation: A person with whom one has a bond of mutual affection. The most common word for friend in Japanese.

examples.japanese: 友達と映画を見ました。
examples.english: I watched a movie with my friend.

examples.japanese: 新しい友達ができました。
examples.notes: 友達ができる = to make a friend

examples.english: I want to meet my friend.

notes: 友達 is the standard word for friend. It can refer to one friend or friends in general (Japanese doesn't always mark plurality). Related words: 親友 (しんゆう, close friend), 友人 (ゆうじん, friend - more formal). To make friends: 友達を作る or 友達ができる.
